effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with [Kyubimon], [Taomon] or [Sakuyamon] in its name, and 1 [Rika Nonaka] or 1 Option card with a cost of 2 or more among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you use an Option card with a cost of 2 or more, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gains ＜Security A. -1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 fewer security card.) until the end of their turn.
